name: VMS - Fulfillment, Assembly and Warehousing
old_description: Our mission here at VMS Inc., a 3PL and fulfillment provider, is to seamlessly connect businesses with tailored, efficient, and innovative service solutions. Through cutting-edge technology, unparalleled expertise, and a commitment to excellence, we aim to optimize supply chains, streamline operations, and enhance customer service and satisfaction. Together, we navigate challenges, deliver reliability, and create lasting partnerships that drive growth and success for our clients in an ever-evolving marketplace.
about:
Vermont Manufacturing Services (VMS) operates from West Rutland, Vermont, where it has provided contract manufacturing, fulfillment, and packaging services for more than 30 years. The company was acquired in 2011 by Jessica Dambrackas, who purchased the business from its previous incarnation as Rutland Industries.

The company runs a 12,000-square-foot facility with climate-controlled warehousing and loading docks. Its services span kitting, packaging, and assembly (including hand assembly), pick-and-pack order fulfillment, e-commerce integration, warehousing, cross-docking, quality control, distribution, and inventory management.

VMS serves electronic manufacturers, food packaging companies, e-commerce retailers, fashion labels, and publishing houses such as the Rutland Herald.

Dambrackas established a mission to employ as many individuals with disabilities as possible, and the company operates on lean manufacturing principles. VMS also emphasizes fixed pricing to simplify forecasting and offers e-commerce software that connects to shopping carts within minutes.
